resources.string: Tunes Pixel Launcher\'s app open and close animations.
Waiting for the Xposed framework. If this stays, enable Animatuna in Vector (or LSPosed) with Pixel Launcher in its scope.
The Xposed framework went away; reopen this screen.

An app grows out of its icon on springs, its size and its shape each at their own pace, as on ColorOS, instead of on Pixel Launcher\'s fixed half-second curve. The opening duration below slows or quickens the springs.
Catch an opening app with the gesture (experimental)
A swipe home while an app still opens takes the window where it is, instead of jumping it to full screen first. Not working yet: the home screen can blink and the window can land in the wrong place.

After the gesture home, the window flies into its icon on ColorOS\'s softer springs, carried by your finger\'s speed, with a touch of bounce as it lands. The gesture home sliders below adjust it from there.
Changes take effect at the next animation. After installing or updating the module, restart Pixel Launcher once.
